home.title: Call your customers when their order is ready — on their own phone
home.subtitle: Tanbeeh replaces plastic buzzers. The customer scans a QR code, and their phone and your TV screen alert them the moment staff tap Ready. No app to install.
home.trialNote: No card needed for the trial.

issue.title: Issue a digital ticket
issue.body: At the counter, staff tap New ticket. The customer scans the QR code and follows their order number.

ready.title: Tap Ready
ready.body: When the order is ready, staff tap Ready. The customer's phone and the TV screen in the restaurant show the number with sound.

collect.title: The customer collects
collect.body: The customer comes to the counter and staff mark the order Collected. Reports show waiting and pickup times.

noApp.title: No app for customers
noApp.body: Works in the phone browser with push notifications where supported and a live page everywhere else.

tv.title: TV display

arabic.title: Arabic and English

reports.title: Simple reports

cashier.title: One button for the cashier.
cashier.body: The staff board runs in the browser of any tablet or phone at the counter.
items: Orders sort themselves into Preparing and Ready.
A bell next to each number shows whether the customer turned alerts on.
Tapped Ready by mistake? Undo it with one tap.
Signed in with a link and a PIN. No special device, no installation.

tv.title: Any TV becomes a pickup screen.
tv.body: Pair a smart TV or a tablet with a 6-digit code. New ready numbers light up and are announced out loud, in Arabic and English.

reach.title: What if the phone is locked?
reach.body: The alert takes three routes, so it reaches the customer even when one of them cannot.

items.title: Notification
items.body: Once the customer turns on alerts, the phone rings even when locked or in a pocket.

items.title: Live page
items.body: While the order page is open, it plays a loud alarm and vibrates until the customer taps "I'm coming".

items.title: Pickup screen
items.body: The TV shows the number and announces it, for anyone whose phone is out of battery.

reach.footnote: Staff see which route each customer has, so they know who to call out by voice.

pos.title: Works with your cashier system.
items: Create tickets from your POS or ordering system with the API.
The receipt number from your system links to the customer number, and Ready rings the phone.
Webhooks tell your systems when an order is ready or collected.
Ready-made connections to popular POS systems are coming soon.
pos.start: No integration needed to start: a QR poster on the counter is enough.

includedItems: Page in your colours and logo
pricing.chains: Several branches or a chain? Talk to us about a price.

items.a: No. Tanbeeh is free for your customers. They only need their phone and its browser.

items.q: Do customers need to install an app?
items.a: No. The order page opens in the phone browser after scanning. They can add it to the home screen if they like.

items.q: Does the phone ring when the screen is locked?
items.a: Yes, once the customer turns on alerts. On iPhone this works after adding the page to the home screen (iOS 16.4 or later). If notifications are off, the open page sounds an alarm and the pickup screen calls the number.

items.q: What if the customer's battery dies?
items.a: The pickup screen still shows and announces the number. Staff can also see that this customer has no active alert and call them out.
The staff board shows that it is offline and catches up as soon as the connection returns. Customer pages reconnect by themselves.

items.q: What if someone photographs the QR code?
items.a: Each order has its own code. The code on the counter poster asks for the order number and a short claim code from the receipt, or for staff approval.
With the staff link and a 4-digit PIN. The device stays signed in, and you can give each person their own PIN.

items.q: Does Tanbeeh connect to my POS?
items.a: Yes, through the API and webhooks today. Ready-made connections to popular POS systems are coming soon.
Arabic and English. You choose which languages each branch shows, and the pickup screen announces in both.

closing.title: Order's up? Make it ring.
